name: Kate rabinowitz Rameshwar das james Lytton and razzle
text: We are thinking of you constantly. Know that this support is here in every step and there is great power when offering to beings beyond ourselves. Keep offering and breathing and loving. You are in our hearts and I worked extra hard at the gym yesterday in your honor. And rest well. Love you!!

name: Amen Ness
text: Great work Aaron!!! Be safe and Live you!

name: Jake and Timon here--
text: We are very impressed! Keep it up Aaron, it's so incredible that you can do this. Wishing you success and a quick pace! Be careful, stay safe, and watch out for wolves. We want to hear about it when we see you next.
